bio: I am currently pursuing my Ph.D. degree in School of Mathematics at Southwest Jiaotong University. My research centers on coding theory, with current interests in synchronization-error correction and coding problems arising from DNA data storage, especially in the context of deletion and insertion codes.

I have published work on error-correcting codes, finite fields, Walsh transforms, and cryptographic functions. From October 2024 to October 2026, I am a visiting Ph.D. student in the Science, Mathematics and Technology Cluster at the Singapore University of Technology and Design.
